title: PruneShift: A Framework for Evaluating Decision Reliability in Structured Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structured pruning uses surrogate objectives because direct task evaluation over every feasible mask is too expensive. Most evaluations report average surrogate error or rank correlation on broadly sampled masks. These summaries do not directly test the mask chosen by the surrogate. We introduce PruneShift, an evaluation framework that separates broad predictive fidelity, fidelity near selector outputs, and the quality of the selected pruning decision. We first prove that Spearman and Kendall agreement can approach one while normalized selection regret remains maximal. We then derive sufficient conditions based on uniform error, selector suboptimality, decision margin, density ratio, and comparison mass. The analysis also yields a finite pool certificate with an explicit excess cost bound. Four studies test different links in this argument. External TextbookQA confirmation is heterogeneous: 7 of 20 simultaneous intervals favor the surrog

translated_title: PruneShift：一个用于评估结构化剪枝中决策可靠性的框架
translated_abstract: 结构化剪枝使用代理目标，因为对每个可行的掩码进行直接任务评估的代价过高。大多数评估报告的是在广泛采样的掩码上的平均代理误差或秩相关性。这些汇总指标并不能直接检验代理所选择的那个掩码。我们提出了PruneShift，这是一个评估框架，它将广泛预测保真度、选择器输出附近的保真度以及所选剪枝决策的质量这三个方面分离开来。我们首先证明了Spearman和Kendall一致性可以接近于1，而归一化选择遗憾却仍然处于最大值。随后，我们基于均匀误差、选择器次优性、决策边际、密度比和比较质量推导出了充分条件。该分析还给出了一个带有显式超额成本界限的有限池证书。四项研究检验了这一论证中的不同环节。外部TextbookQA确认呈现异质性：20个同时置信区间中有7个支持代理（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出PruneShift评估框架，将结构化剪枝中代理目标的评估解耦为广泛预测保真度、选择器输出附近的保真度和所选剪枝决策质量三个层面，证明了高秩相关性可能伴随最大选择遗憾，并推导出保证剪枝决策质量的充分条件与有限池证书。
en_tdlr: PruneShift is an evaluation framework for structured pruning that decouples broad surrogate fidelity from the reliability of the selected pruning decision, proving that near-perfect Spearman/Kendall agreement can coexist with maximal normalized selection regret, and deriving sufficient conditions and a finite-pool certificate with explicit excess cost bounds for decision quality.
